hypothesis: Separate pitch selectors and outcome experts compound calibration error. A single multiclass model over the Cartesian product of reverse_any control outcome and counter-reconstructed pitch group can learn the joint distribution directly, with success obtained by exact marginalization over pitch groups.

relationship_to_prior_work.outcome_context_schemes: Prior joint labels split outcomes by count, game type, call, or 15 counter patterns, not by the nearly complete reconstructed pitch group.
relationship_to_prior_work.dense_moe: Prior dense model separately estimated P(group|x) and P(success|group,x), then multiplied two fitted systems.
relationship_to_prior_work.new_structure: One CatBoost MultiClass objective estimates P(outcome,group|x); no separate selector, manual correction, or expert blend inside the model.
